data.action: 矮桌旁核对完花束预算合上家计簿，向镜头露出没有超支的满足笑
data.description: 【白银家公寓客厅·清晨】圭穿着简洁的银白婚纱坐在矮桌前，旁边仍放着她整理过的家计簿与一束便宜但新鲜的小花；她核对完最后一笔预算，才抬眼向镜头露出“这次没有超支”的满足笑。
data.lighting: gentle morning light across the low table
data.mood: 把精打细算也变成花嫁幸福
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane from Kaguya-sama: Love Is War wears a simple silver-white bridal dress with a black ribbon headband, modest veil and a small budget-friendly flower bouquet. She sits at the low table with her household ledger beside a small bouquet chosen for its sensible price. After checking the final figure, she closes the book and gives the viewer a modest, satisfied smile as morning light reaches the silver fabric. gentle morning light across the low table.
data.title: 白银圭 · 预算表旁的银色花嫁
